context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 校正/無条件/専属/協賛/巻頭/研修生/組み込む/見越し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、校正は、執筆者と編集者、両方の責任だ。
lines.en: Ren — proofreading is a shared responsibility between author and editor both.
lines.style: Calm, measured delivery. Leans forward slightly. The opening 「蓮」 is direct but not harsh. Pause after the dash. Each clause lands with quiet authority — not lecturing, instructing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。無条件に信頼する文化、御社に感じます。
lines.en: Yes. I can feel that culture of unconditional trust here at your company.
lines.style: Careful, respectful. Slightly formal in construction. Breath comes up on 「感じます」 — genuine appreciation mixed with nervous awareness he's being observed. Lean-in attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 専属の若手、君も憧れの存在になれ。
lines.en: And you — become someone the in-house young staff aspire to be.
lines.style: Directional but not cold. Slight weight on 「君も」 — making it personal. The tone shifts to something almost encouraging beneath the instruction. Brief, purposeful pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 協賛企業との関係、信頼関係、大事ですね。
lines.en: The relationships with sponsor companies matter. Trust is everything there too.
lines.style: Eager forward momentum. Slight stumble on the opening — he's gathering his thoughts aloud. Genuine observation rather than performance. Pace picks up on 「大事」 — he's recognizing something.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 巻頭の見開き、デザインも参考になる。
lines.en: The lead spread — the design work in there teaches you something.
lines.style: Pointed observation. Not a question; a statement of fact delivered with gentle firmness. The pace is steady. Slight emphasis on 「参考になる」 — 'look at this, really look at it.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研修生として、編集の流れに、組み込むことを許可いただけますか。
lines.en: As a trainee, could I be included in the editing workflow from here?
lines.style: Formal, respectfully hesitant. The request builds across the sentence but lands quietly — not presumptuous. Slight breathiness on the verb form. Eye contact held but deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。将来を見越して、業務、覚えていけ。
lines.en: Yes. Learn the work with an eye toward your future.
lines.style: Brief, affirming. Warm underneath the brevity. 「将来を見越して」 delivered with quiet confidence — like he's already decided this is possible. Close with settled certainty.
